Drugs in the City 2

By: Johann Botha | Delivery

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
Even more flavoured hard drugs aimed at children hit the market

Summary:
We recently showed that the existence of Strawberry Quik, a candy version of chrystal meths does exist. We also showed that you can buy Cat with your credit card in a top nightclub. This time we bring some of the massive reaction that the story generated and reveal more scary hard drugs hitting our schools

Further information:
Thanks to our story a parent got suspicious when his 12 year old son suddenly got heart palpitations etc on friday and was admitted to hospital. The parents questioned the son and then heard that he had bought sherbet from a friend at the same prestigious school. We had the sherbet tested (and filmed it) with a field testing kit and it showed positive for both cocaine and cat (amphetamine). We then took it to an independant pathological lab where it tested negative.
We also sourced five different flavours of strawberry quik which then tested positive at the same laborotary.
We will also film a drug producer showing us how they "cook" cat and crystal meth, and the horrendous ingredients such as hydrochloric and sulphuric acids that go into the mix.
We will also give an update on the Shell garage where the school children used to buy their drugs.
We will also go on a drug bust with JMPD
We will also visit the Randburg taxi ranks where sales of drugs to minors is a major problem.

Expert:
Mr. Quintin van Kerken CEO Anti Drug Alliance
Dr. Rene van der Watt Chemical Pathologist

Gauteng

Press Release:


Candy to a baby
We take our recent investigation into the war on drugs even further as we uncover sinister manoeuvring by dealers targeting children through their peers. Carte Blanche asks – is your child safe from other learners selling sweets laced with drugs on the school playground?


Script:


Openingscene met kinders en lekkergoed
Childhood – the one time in your life when you are supposed to be safe. But how do you as parent protect your child when you're at work, or they are in the care of others, and other grownups who might very intentionally try to harm them?

Two weeks ago we proved the existence of Strawberry Quik, a flavoured form of crystal meth that looks just like a well known sweet that comes in a straw. Since 2008 rumours about this form of the drug have been surfacing, but every time it was debunked by experts as an urban legend.

Quintin van Kerken of the anti drug alliance tested the sample we sourced on the street and was stunned ...
Quintin
If this has to get on to the market, we are going to have a very, very serious problem, with the children in our country.
Bongani walking into building
To verify the results of Quintin's field tester, we took the straws to one of the big independent pathology labs.
Rene
Rene: I've got the result right here and it tested positive for metamphetamine, which is also known by its street name called chrystal meth or tik
Bongani: So this is positive beyond any doubt?
Rene: Yes, this is like a fingerprint for the analyser and it will for example stand up in any court.
V/o
We know that crystal meth is a deadly drug, but one of the scariest aspects of giving this to little children is the fact that it chemically increases one’s your libido, even if children don't understand what that means.


V/o
To make matters worse, we have since found samples of these straws in different flavours, allegedly containing different strengths of crystal meth, to gradually get the children used to the bitter taste, and to create a new generation of addicts
V/o
The caramel flavour would be seen as the top end and that is the one that is the strongest. The problem seems to be at its worst in local taxi ranks.

Selling drugs to learners is considered a crime against children and therefore caries a harsher penalty than normal dealing. Dealers therefore employ clever disguises.
Gladys
Sometimes in the foyer here, in the corridor. You will find a man sitting there with a Bible, surrounded by school children. We're thinking that he's converting them, and in the mean time he is the main man
V/o
She says this person only takes the money. They are not quite sure who makes the delivery
Bongani Link with box
Not all traders who work in a taxi rank are licenced to be here. There are many who sell crisps and peanuts in boxes like this, and it is believed it may be them who are the delivery men, because who's to say what is underneath here.
Gladys
Gladys: Ive seen children being dazed, children collapsing in the taxi rank.
Bon: I've even heard sometimes the kids even have sex?
Gladys: Openly. Openly, and I don't think this children when they are in this act are normal.
V/o
From the taxi rank, we go into the suburbs, to the petrol station where we saw schoolchildren buying drugs in our previous story. RandPark High school has since sent letters out warning learners of possible expulsion if they are just seen close to the mail boxes where the drug dealers hang out.
Bon link by garage and swchool
Well, since our expose all the stakeholders have co-operated together, to try to clean up the neighbourhood. But is it a losing battle.

Literally a block from the school, there is a drug rehab centre and in the street outside, a homeless man who says he has been working that same corner for twenty eight years, pointed out somebody who was rapidly moving away from us towards the petrol station near the school.
Tony
See that guy walking down the road there? Take a photo. He's selling to young children from the school here.
V/o
We see him cross the street and meet up with somebody else who then goes and hides something in the grass before following the first man.
Tony
He's stashing his drugs under the trees there between the grass and everything.
V/o
Tony says that after our recent exposé on drugs in the area that the dealers moved away from the petrol station and started selling to the school kids here. He says even some of the rehab patients sneak out to buy from them.
Tony
The guys that are in there for... it's a drug rehabilitation centre. They're coming to buy here on the corner, that's why the ou's are selling here on the corner
V/o
Tony recently lost his best friend who worked the corner with him.
Tony crying
Tony: Once he's got the money he used to buy the drugs from this guy.
Bon: So how did he die?
Tony: From a overdose. He's dead. And what this ouk is doing bra..There's a lot of people around in this Randpark Ridge, are gonna lose their children, if they don't listen to what i've got to say. Because i've told the police how many times, they don't want to listen.

But we also still had phone numbers of dealers who would deliver to the kids. We decided to test the system and the JMPD agreed to help. We ordered late at night, and after the dealer delivered the drugs, the JMPD pulled him over as he drove away and found some CAT in his car. Eventually he took us to his flat, which just so happened to be on Tony's corner, opposite the rehab centre. They ransacked the flat but couldn't find the big supply they were hoping for. They did find a scale, typically used to measure out the cat in grams, and a suspicious amount of credit cards and cell phones. They also found some payout slips from a sports betting shop, showing amounts of up to three quarters of a million rand paid out on a single R20 bet. The police told me that this is typical of how dealers launder the cash back into the system, by paying someone at the shop to issue an imaginary receipt on a real winning number from the previous day. With this in hand, the money can now be banked without raising alarm bells.

Of course one can't make payments like this every day into the same account, and that could explain why this man had so many different accounts.



We found someone who has cooked CAT for many years, and he agreed to let us film the process.

To convert the active ingredient into the end product it has to go through a number of steps. Steps which include adding really deadly substances.
Cook
The chromate is highly carcinogenic. The sulphuric acid and the drain cleaner, caustic soda, speaks for itself.

Towards the end of the process the mixture is washed a number of times to remove the deadliest ingredients. But bearing in mind that the cook wants to harvest the maximum number of grams from each batch in the shortest possible time, and that he doesn't even know the person who will buy it, chances are that he will cut some corners and some of these killer ingredients will remain in the final product.
Cook
I will never buy cat on the street

But even without these ingredients, CAT is still pretty deadly
Cook
These are not health supplements you know. Although they could make you feel on top of the world

The deadly allure of these substances has the potential to turn addiction among increasingly younger children into a pandemic. This is a reality we will have to face.
Tony
It's going to be, it's an absolute fuckup. Kids will get a taste for drugs. It will be devastating if you're giving this to like a 13 year old, you know.
Because adults have a problem managing it.
